theorems.name: Submission.cmcdtfrfg_face_isometry_diam
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (ι : Fin k → Fin P) (b : Fin P → ℤ), Function.Injective ι → (∀ y y' : Euclid k, dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (b i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (b i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)) = dist y y') ∧ (∀ y y' : Euclid k, (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ y' i ∧ y' i ≤ 1) → dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (b i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (b i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)) ≤ Real.sqrt P)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
